lf-diagram.description: A diagram rendered from a Mermaid-source body by Beautiful Mermaid. It supports flowcharts, stateDiagram-v2, sequenceDiagram, classDiagram, erDiagram, and xychart-beta. The body is data, not prose: text inside its <pre>, HTML-escaped (& first, then the angle brackets). Flowcharts accept Mermaid's classic node shapes; classDef can style them with Leaf tokens such as var(--ok-tint), var(--ok), and var(--ok-ink). The whole diagram is one Comment target. Boxes listed in `parts` as `node:SOURCE_ID` expose individual targets, where SOURCE_ID is the authored id of a flowchart node or subgraph, state or composite state, sequence participant, class, or ER entity. Unlisted boxes and diagrams authored without `parts` keep only the whole-diagram target. Edges, sequence messages, and chart marks have no stable source id and cannot be listed as parts.
lf-diagram.x-example:
flowchart LR
  Cart([Cart]) --> Pay{Paid?}
  Pay --> Receipt[(Receipt)]
  classDef done fill:var(--ok-tint),stroke:var(--ok),color:var(--ok-ink)
  class Receipt done
